_curation_note: PQSigner semantic curation: mint, redeem, and withdraw are admitted only for the fixed Core mainnet Earn UUPS proxy below. At block 37311927 its EIP-1967 implementation was 0x62c5e03a5bfa0d6af08b81165a9eb87d1c8b8a0b; official Earn source at commit 4d237f6a366df6a6953cb0abfea4e68cafa9e7d9, Solidity 0.8.4, optimizer 200, and OpenZeppelin 4.9.3 reproduces that runtime exactly after linking the documented UUPS self immutable. mint binds the validator and exact CORE input but no minimum stCORE output. redeem burns the exact stCORE input and queues a live-rate CORE amount minus a live protocol fee. withdraw pays every matured caller record, so its amount is state-derived. Evidence is historical fixed-block source/runtime authority, not live rates, fees, limits, pause state, maturity, validator state, execution success, future proxy upgrades, fallback, or blind signing. See tests/erc7730-semantic-evidence/corestake-sei-avvatar.
